meta.delegation_note_pt: Testes reais mostram que delegar vendas para Lucia ou Nico reduz o pagamento entre 58% e 66% (US$ 45.000 viram ~US$ 17.000).
meta.delegation_note_en: Tested runs confirm delegating sales to Lucia or Nico cuts payout by 58%–66% ($45,000 drops to ~$17,000).

routes.req_pt: Fim do Cap. 4 (That's Where the Money Is...) + Dye Pack Jammer
routes.req_en: Late Ch. 4 (That's Where the Money Is...) + Dye Pack Jammer
routes.vehicle_pt: Carro rápido + troca de veículo na fuga
routes.vehicle_en: Fast getaway car + clean vehicle swap
routes.tip_pt: NÃO exploda a van na rua. Siga a van blindada até o banco e entre no cofre gigante assim que o guarda abrir!
routes.tip_en: Do NOT blow the van on the street. Tail the armored truck to the bank and slip into the open vault behind the guard!

routes.name_pt: Circuito de 5 Bancos de Van (Sem Estrelas)
routes.req_pt: Cap. 3 + Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check) + 3 looks no porta-malas
routes.req_en: Ch. 3 + Dye Pack Jammer (Credit Check) + 3 trunk outfits
routes.vehicle_pt: Van / Carrinha (10 sacos na carga + 4 no casal = 14 sacos)
routes.vehicle_en: Cargo Van (10 trunk bags + 4 on duo = 14 bags total)
routes.tip_pt: 3 bancos em Downtown + 1 Sul/Leste + 1 Oeste. Abra cofres com código do escritório (sem bomba) e passe no Spray.
routes.tip_en: 3 Downtown banks + 1 South/East + 1 West. Use office safe codes (no explosives), swap full outfits & hit Pay 'n' Spray.

routes.req_pt: Cap. 1+ (após Hey, Arnold! e Island Dreams)
routes.tip_pt: Zero polícia! Cada set completo paga de US$ 50k a US$ 200k e ainda fecha as 33 descobertas do 100%.
routes.tip_en: Zero police heat! Complete sets pay $50k–$200k while knocking out all 33 Underwater Discoveries for 100%.

routes.vehicle_pt: Carro com porta-malas aberto na saída
routes.vehicle_en: Car parked at exit with trunk popped open
routes.tip_pt: Eleva golpes comuns de US$ 10k para até US$ 50k. Desligue DVR + alarme e entregue pessoalmente em Capri.
routes.tip_en: Boosts regular store jobs from $10k up to $50k. Kill DVR + alarm panel and hand-deliver to Capri.

routes.req_pt: Cap. 3 + Key Cloner (Balsero) • Red Trackers no Cap. 4
routes.req_en: Ch. 3 + Key Cloner (Balsero) • Red Trackers in Ch. 4
routes.vehicle_pt: Pegassi / Grotti / Emerus em perfeito estado
routes.tip_pt: Mansões no norte de Capri e Ilha Vespucci têm pouca vigilância. Mantenha alta velocidade se houver rastreador vermelho.
routes.tip_en: North Capri & Vespucci mansions have light security. Stay at highway speed if an Advanced Tracker is active.

routes.tip_pt: Entre sem arma longa. Destrua o DVR, desative o alarme, leia o Post-it da senha e limpe cofre + vitrines.
routes.tip_en: Enter without long guns. Destroy DVR, disable alarm box, read the Post-it safe code, and clear displays.

routes.req_pt: Cap. 3 + Bombas Adesivas + Dye Pack Jammer
routes.req_en: Ch. 3 + Sticky Bombs + Dye Pack Jammer
routes.vehicle_pt: Veículo pesado para bloqueio em reta
routes.vehicle_en: Heavy blocker vehicle on a straight road
routes.tip_pt: Bloqueie na reta, exploda as portas traseiras, pegue as notas marcadas e suma em túnel contra 4 estrelas.
routes.tip_en: Block on a straightaway, blow rear doors, grab marked bills, and dive into a train tunnel to lose 4 stars.

routes.req_pt: Cap. 2+ + Armas Silenciadas (Permit Keys / Wetman Bay)
routes.req_en: Ch. 2+ + Silenced Weapons (Permit Keys / Wetman Bay)
routes.vehicle_pt: Van ou SUV para carregar sacos + relógios
routes.vehicle_en: Van or SUV for duffel bags & luxury watches
routes.tip_pt: Rende narcóticos, relógios raros e variantes únicas de armas. Colete 100% do saque para contar nos 100%!
routes.tip_en: Yields narcotics, luxury watches & unique weapon variants. Collect every single valuable for 100% credit!

routes.tip_pt: Melhor farm seguro do Capítulo 2 sem tiroteio. Paga de US$ 1k a US$ 20k dependendo do modelo.
routes.tip_en: Safest zero-combat grind in Chapter 2. Pays $1k–$20k depending on the model.

routes.tip_pt: Faça Shirley's Rum (~US$ 1.3k) + Brian (Hey, Arnold!) para travar US$ 5k na Family Savings (+US$ 2k de juros = US$ 7k salvos!).
routes.tip_en: Do Shirley's Rum (~$1.3k) + Brian (Hey, Arnold!) to lock $5k in Family Savings (+$2k interest = $7k saved!).
